hero.lede: SilkCover Consulting helps institutions, investors and programmes decide with evidence, engage the people who matter, and build lasting capability.

section.title: A consultancy built on three lines of thought
section.lede: SilkCover Consulting works with organisations that need sound evidence, clear strategy and effective engagement. Our identity draws on the geometry of Herat’s tilework: many lines, one coherent pattern.
section.caption: One figure, three lines. Choose a principle to trace it.

principles.title: Global perspective
principles.text: We bring international standards, methods and networks to every assignment.

principles.title: Cultural depth
principles.text: We understand the languages, institutions and histories that shape how decisions are made on the ground.

principles.title: Strategic thinking
principles.text: We connect evidence to decisions, so every finding has a use and every recommendation has a reason.

section.title: {count} disciplines, drawn as one pattern
section.text: Each service stands on its own. The lines show where they reinforce each other. Choose a service, or filter by the kind of organisation you are.

section.title: Four stages, each built on the last
section.text: The same discipline applies whether we are running a survey or a conference.

section.title: Different sectors, different patterns
section.text: Each sector has its own pressures. Select one to see the services that usually answer them.

section.title: Notes from the field
section.text: Perspectives on research, markets, institutions and dialogue.

closing.title: Start a conversation
closing.text: Whether you need evidence for a decision, a room full of the right people, or a team ready to deliver, tell us where you are starting from.
